name: Ichinomiya Taizan
source:
Nogawa's junior at university.
A burly man that was born into a temple family and runs an exorcism business.
Despite his wild looks and joking Osaka dialect making him come across as shady, he's skill enough to be highly respected in those circles.
He goes way back with Nogawa, who ends up having to rely on him because of certain circumstances.

[Translated from the [url=https://game.mages.co.jp/shikai/#character]official website[/url]]
